One grey Tuesday, tangled in the kelp on the rocks below, he spotted a glass bottle glinting in the surf. Inside was a rolled sheet of paper, its ink blurred by seawater. The handwriting was careful and slanted: 'If you are reading this, the tide has carried you to me as it carried me here. Keep the light burning.' Tomas read it three times. He had never received a letter in forty years of keeping watch, and he wondered who had written it, and when. That night he climbed the stairs slowly, lit the lamp, and wrote his reply on the back of his own log page, sealed it in an empty bottle, and tossed it toward the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市渐渐安静下来。高架桥上的车灯稀疏地划过，像一条条没有尽头的光带。便利店的玻璃门里，店员低头整理货架，白色的灯光洒在空荡的走廊上。远处的工地还亮着灯，塔吊静静地立着，等待天亮后的喧嚣。路边的早餐铺已经升起了白雾，蒸笼里的包子散发着热气。偶尔有环卫工人推着车缓缓走过，扫帚摩擦地面的声音格外清晰。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有少数几扇还亮着，那里或许有人在熬夜，或许有人刚刚醒来。这座城市在沉睡与苏醒之间停留着，短暂而安静，仿佛所有的烦恼都被夜色暂时收藏起来。", "w03": "- Recursion means a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- Like Russian nesting dolls, each doll opens to reveal a smaller one until the smallest.\n- Every recursion needs a stop point, or it keeps going forever."}
